decisions.source_issue: R54 and P97–102 emphasize risk maps, warnings, evacuation and local contacts; a fictional route, shelter or old directory is not operational authority.
decisions.decision: Use a fictional map and verification fields. Treat PAGASA warnings and local DRRM orders as distinct. Confirm current accessible route, shelter, contact and timestamp before relaying instructions.
decisions.remaining: Barangay DRRM and health leads must review actual maps, warning channels, accessible shelters, routes and contacts.

decisions.source_issue: R54–55 and P102–104 recommend a go-bag/e-balde; a generic list may overlook a household’s medicines, infants or portability.
decisions.decision: Use the current DOH advisory as a starting checklist, then tailor the example to household needs and review expiry. Do not dispense or prescribe.
decisions.remaining: Confirm local hazard-specific contents, medicine continuity, supply access and emergency transport with local staff.

decisions.source_issue: R55 and P104–107 describe a pandemic-era BHERT arrangement that cannot establish today’s fixed team composition or authority.
decisions.decision: Teach confirmation of current response lead, BHW role, reporting channel and minimum-necessary handover. Exclude fixed team size, contact-tracing/isolation mandates and clinical or enforcement duties.
decisions.remaining: Local DRRM and health authorities must confirm current team roster, BHW scope, privacy practice and handover protocol.

decisions.source_issue: R56–57 and P107–112 list EHSP domains, but include fixed targets and broad PFA effects that should not become universal BHW promises.
decisions.decision: Keep medical/public health, nutrition, WASH and MHPSS as referral domains. Use safe, consent-based practical support and referral for distress; do not prescribe, declare water safe, deliver therapy or promise recovery. Avoid fixed 24-hour targets.
decisions.remaining: Qualified local clinical, WASH, nutrition and MHPSS leads must validate service pathways, referral urgency and responder support.
